paper_title: Exact Byzantine Consensus on Arbitrary Directed Graphs Under Local Broadcast Model
statement: In this work, we have presented tight conditions for exact binary Byzantine consensus in directed graphs under the local broadcast model. The sufficiency proof in Section 6 is constructive. However, the algorithm has exponential round complexity. We leave finding a more efficient algorithm for future work. The following question is also open: does there exist an efficient algorithm to check if a given directed graph satisfies condition SC?
